articles.title: Starboard’s Dynatrace Play: Activist Turnaround or Setup for a Splunk-Style Sale?
articles.summary: Starboard Value just secured two board seats at Dynatrace and a billion-dollar buyback authorization, moves that echo its Splunk campaign almost exactly before Cisco swooped in with a $28 billion offer. Whether history repeats depends on signals that are only starting to emerge.
